escalation: Three findings, none expressible as a patch op. (a) content.senses[1] is a grammar-only block (verbal_stem 'Ithpa.', binyan_form 'אִיתַּגַּר') with no definition and no child senses, while the Ithpe. sibling carries all the text; no patch op writes grammar. (b) The Ithpe. section opens with an anchor whose display is 'same' and whose data-ref is 'Jastrow, תגר 1' = V00087, the immediately preceding entry; V00087 is an unvocalized corrigendum stub about Ex. R. s. 37 whose own text reads 'read: שחִגְּרוֹ (חָגַר I)', i.e. a form of חגר 'to gird', not a trading word. In a stem section of an entry carrying no 'ch.' marker, 'same' can only mean this entry's own base stem, so the target is wrong (class 11). The host and target headword skeletons are IDENTICAL (תגר/תגר), so this member is invisible to a skeleton-relatedness carve-out. (c) 'B. Kam. 38ᵃ (not אתגר)' links a reading the text explicitly denies, and the link resolves to אֲגַר II (skeleton אגר), not the word the display names (skeleton אתגר) — a mislink on top of a corrigendum (class 11).

Class 11 wrong-link-target: 'Pes. 50ᵇ, a. e. ת׳ סימטא, v. סִימְטָא I' carries data-ref 'Jastrow, סִימְטָא ² 1' = O00700, whose article is 'abscess, carbuncle'. The display's own Roman numeral says I, and the sense required by 'merchants of the simta' is O00699 סִימְטָא, 'recess, alley adjoining an open place to which merchants retire'. Display numeral and data-ref numeral disagree; the correct target is the bare-headword entry O00699.

Two class 11 wrong-link-targets. (a) The etymology '(v. תִגְרָא I)' targets 'Jastrow, תִגְרָא ² 1' = V00093, whose entire article is 'crutch, staff, v. תִגְדָּא'. This entry glosses 'quarrelsome man', so the required sense is V00092 תִגְרָא 'strife, contest, complaint' — the bare-headword member, which is Jastrow's I. Display numeral and data-ref numeral disagree. (b) The feminine variant abbreviation 'תִי׳' targets V00014 תִאוּבְתָּא 'desire', an unrelated word that does not begin with the abbreviated consonants; corpus-wide, 15 of 16 תִי׳ anchors sink to that same entry irrespective of host. Neither is repairable from bytes present in this entry.

Three class 11 wrong-link-targets in the printed plural/variant list. (a) 'Pl. תַדִּין, תַדַּיָּא' targets V00105 תדיא, an unvocalized corrigendum stub whose entire text is ', Targ. Prov. Lag. ח׳)', so the linker indexed ח׳ against that entry. The intended referent is the ח-initial variant of this entry's own plural.

Class 11 wrong-link-target, niqqud twin: 'read: תָהֲיָא, v. תְּהֵי' — the first anchor targets 'Jastrow, תָהֵי 1' = V00124, the second targets V00123 תְּהֵי. The two headwords share one consonantal skeleton (תהי) and are told apart only by vocalization, so the niqqud carve-out cannot decide it. V00123 (language_code ' ch.
